<?php
class GetOption107 {
    public string $id; public string $option;
    public function __construct($id,$option) {$this->id=$id;$this->option=$option;}
    public function __toString():string {echo "T:",$this->id,":",$GLOBALS["stage"],";";return $this->option;}
    public function __destruct() {ini_set("precision",1);echo "D:",$this->id,":",ini_get("precision"),";";}
}
class GetTemporary107 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos=0; public GetOption107 $name;
    public function __construct() {$this->name=new GetOption107("A","precision");}
    public function rewind():void {echo "W;";$this->pos=0;}
    public function valid():bool {echo "V",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos<1;}
    public function current():mixed {echo "C",$this->pos,";";return $this->name;}
    public function key():mixed {echo "K",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos;}
    public function next():void {echo "N",$this->pos,";";$this->pos++;if($this->pos===1){$GLOBALS["stage"]="done";}}
    public function __destruct() {echo "I:",ini_get("precision"),";";}
}
function makeGet107() {$it=new GetTemporary107;$GLOBALS["watch"]=WeakReference::create($it);return $it;}
$stage="walk";$watch=null;echo "B;";
$result=ini_get(...makeGet107());echo "R:",$result,":",($watch->get()===null?1:0),";";
unset($watch);ini_restore("precision");echo "E:",ini_get("precision"),";";
purpose: A one-item temporary Iterator retires before a copied Stringable option converts; its last-owner destructor changes precision 14 to 1 before ini_get reads it.

<?php
class GetSelectedOption107 {
    public string $id; public string $option;
    public function __construct($id,$option) {$this->id=$id;$this->option=$option;}
    public function __toString():string {echo "T:",$this->id,":",$GLOBALS["stage"],";";return $this->option;}
    public function __destruct() {ini_set("precision",1);echo "D:",$this->id,":",ini_get("precision"),";";}
}
class GetSelectedValues107 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos=0;
    public function rewind():void {echo "W;";$this->pos=0;}
    public function valid():bool {echo "V",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos<1;}
    public function current():mixed {echo "C",$this->pos,";";return $GLOBALS["name"];}
    public function key():mixed {echo "K",$this->pos,";";if($this->pos===0){$GLOBALS["name"]=new GetSelectedOption107("B","display_errors");$GLOBALS["call"]=ini_set(...);}return $this->pos;}
    public function next():void {echo "N",$this->pos,";";$this->pos++;if($this->pos===1){$GLOBALS["stage"]="done";}}
}
$stage="walk";$name=new GetSelectedOption107("A","precision");$it=new GetSelectedValues107;$call=ini_get(...);$keep=$call;echo "B;";
$result=$call(...$it);echo "R:",$result,":",ini_get("precision"),":",$name->id,":",$call("precision",2),":",$keep("precision"),";";
unset($it,$name,$call,$keep);ini_restore("precision");echo "E:",ini_get("precision"),";";
purpose: The selected first-class ini_get survives key-time option/callee rebinding, observes the option destructor precision write, and remains distinct from the rebound setter.
